Anubis’s father—as most traditions say—was **Osiris**.  
Osiris is one of the principal deities in **ancient Egyptian religion** (often called Egyptian mythology).  
> “Parents: Nephthys and Osiris”【1†L15-L20】  
> “Osiris … is the god of the afterlife… in ancient Egyptian religion”【2†L55-L63】

So, the religion that Osiris (and therefore Anubis’s father) belongs to is the ancient Egyptian religious tradition.
